福爾摩沙小導遊臺南 Tainan・中西區

藥王廟Medicine King Temple

認識藥王之謎、坐西朝東的五行意義、往上長的廟，還有門釘九九八十一和榕松公。

Learn the Medicine King mystery, why the temple faces east, and what to look for.

這座廟站了三百年，但還沒有人說得準，壇上坐的究竟是哪一位神明。廟方說是嚐百草的神農；市區史蹟調查則說是名醫扁鵲。1764 年重建時坐西朝東，正對水仙宮。在五行裡，東方屬木、色青、對應春天。1969 年開路拆掉了中殿和後殿。沒有腹地，就把殿往上蓋到二樓、三樓。數數門釘：九排九顆。找找 1788 年的古匾，再拜訪三百歲的老榕樹。農曆四月二十八，各地分香廟回來，廟方還會發送草藥茶。

This temple has stood for three hundred years, and nobody can say for certain which god sits on its altar. The temple says he is Shennong, who tasted a hundred herbs. A city survey says he is Bian Que, a legendary doctor. In 1764 the temple was rebuilt facing east, straight toward Shuixian Temple. In the Five Elements, east means wood, green and spring. In 1969, a new road cut through the temple. With no land left, the halls were rebuilt upward on the second and third floors. Count the door studs: nine rows of nine. Find the plaque from 1788, and greet the three-hundred-year-old banyan tree. On the twenty-eighth day of the fourth lunar month, branch temples return, and the temple gives out herbal tea.

One-minute intro

為什麼值得來

Why it matters & history
  1. 開基祖廟全台藥王廟的開基祖廟，府城「七寺八廟」之一。This is the founding Medicine King temple of all Taiwan.
  2. 藥王到底是誰？三百年香火，謎團越燒越旺。Three hundred years of incense, and the mystery only deepens.
  3. 往上長的廟1969 年開金華路，中殿後殿被拆；1986 年重建時往上蓋，1990 年完工。With no land to expand, the temple grew upward instead.
  4. 五行與方位東方屬木、色青、對應春天，主生發、主萌芽。East belongs to wood. Its color is green, and its season is spring.

認識景點

About the place

開基祖廟The founding temple

康熙年間創建：一說 1685 年，一說 1718 年；最初在北勢街尾，廟身狹小。 1764 重建，坐西朝東：信徒多到裝不下，集資在現址重建，廟深三進，正對水仙宮。 五馬朝江一回首：與五條港末端五座朝西的廟宇，合成這個風水格局。 醫藥界的守護神：中醫師、藥師、中藥行至今仍會來這裡問好。

Founded in the Kangxi era: One account says 1685, another says 1718. Rebuilt facing east: It was rebuilt in 1764, three halls deep, facing Shuixian Temple. Five horses and one turning its head: With five west-facing temples, it forms a feng shui pattern. Patron of healers: Doctors, pharmacists and herbal shops still come to greet him.

藥王到底是誰？Who is the Medicine King?

神農氏：廟方的說法：嚐百草的神農氏。 扁鵲：史蹟調查的說法：若是神農，應該叫「藥皇」而不是「藥王」。 孫思邈：也有人說是名醫孫思邈。 韋慈藏：還有人說是韋慈藏。

Shennong: The temple says Shennong, who tasted a hundred herbs. Bian Que: A city survey says Bian Que, a legendary physician. Sun Simiao: Some say the great doctor Sun Simiao. Wei Cizang: Others say Wei Cizang.

重要的是好起來：重要的從來不是祂叫什麼名字，而是人們真的好起來了。

What matters: was never his name, but that people got better.

往上長的廟A temple that grew upward

1969 開路：市府開金華路，只剩前殿；老一輩說拆廟那天雷雨交加。 二樓、三樓：把中殿、後殿搬到二樓、三樓。 福壽我民：知府楊廷理所獻古匾，由右往左讀。 楹聯與香爐：1831 年的楹聯與香爐。

A new road: In 1969, a new road took the middle and rear halls. Second and third floors: The middle and rear halls moved to the second and third floors. Blessing and Long Life Upon Our People: A plaque from 1788. Read it right to left. Couplets and incense burner: Couplets and an incense burner from 1831.

籤桶：1869 年的籤桶。

Fortune-lot holder: A fortune-lot holder from 1869.

五行與方位The Five Elements

東方＝木：治病救人的廟坐西朝東，把大門朝向生機。 青色：東方的顏色是青。 春天：東方對應春天，萬物生長。 朝陽：每天清晨，第一道陽光直直照在藥王的臉上。

East is wood: A temple of healing faces east, toward life itself. green: The color of the east is green. spring: The east is the season of spring. the rising sun: Every morning, the first sunlight falls on the Medicine King's face.

北方＝水：北方屬水、色黑。

North is water: and its color is black.

實景照片

Photos on site

往上長的廟 The temple that grew upward

從街上看藥王廟：一層紅色屋頂上面還有一層樓和白色石欄杆。1969 年開路後，廟沒有地方擴建，就把中殿、後殿搬到樓上，往上長。

From the street, you can see the Medicine King Temple rise up, with a white stone balcony. After a new road took its back halls in 1969, the temple grew upward instead.

藥王廟正面 The temple front

藥王廟的正面：屋頂一層一層往上疊，門前有雕龍石柱和一座高高的香爐，左邊的紅門上釘滿金色門釘。

This is the front of the Medicine King Temple. Its roofs rise layer upon layer. Carved dragon pillars stand by the door, and the red doors are covered with golden door studs.

福壽我民 The 1788 plaque

神龕上方掛著「福壽我民」古匾，要由右往左讀，是 1788 年知府楊廷理題的。匾下供奉著藥王。

Above the altar hangs the plaque Blessing and Long Life Upon Our People, from 1788. Read it from right to left. The Medicine King sits below.
